ios.desc:
A new way to use AI, visually.

Buddy is an AI that answers with interactive visuals, not paragraphs of text. Ask a question and it draws — maps, carousels, charts, plans you can check off.

Every answer is made for you uniquely: your language and your aesthetics.

Sharing it with friends is a click away.

Use the web as your hub of connections

The web is yours and any website can be a connection, not just Gmail, Notion or whichever integration is supported. Sign in once, on the site's own page, and Buddy can open and read it for you whenever you ask: your ads dashboard, your inbox, your project tracker, the forum you follow. 

What can you ask?
Anything. But if you want somewhere to start:

• Where should we eat tonight? — a map, ranked picks, and the tradeoffs
• Compare these three, honestly — scored on what you actually care about
• Plan the trip — an itinerary with times, costs, and conflicts
• Teach me this — an explainer with quick practice, so it sticks
• How are our numbers this week? — read straight from your ads dashboard
• The same question every morning — any ask can become a briefing that rebuilds itself

Private by nature
No account, no email, no password — Buddy works without knowing who you are. Your passwords never leave your phone. Your history, bookmarks, and chats are stored there and nowhere else. Your data should be yours

Start free. Buddy Plus raises your limits.

Privacy Policy: https://buddybrowser.ai/privacy

quotes.text:
My friends and I noticed we kept running into the same loop on our phones: ask a chatbot about some stuff, follow the Google links, then back to the chatbot for some follow up questions.

What we really wanted was for the agent to be right beside us on the browser. Seeing exactly what we see and having the ability to actually carry out the tasks. Some stuff like this exists on desktop but there aren't really any good options for mobile, which is where we do most of our browsing.

So we built Buddy. We just launched it on the App Store last week and would love for you to give it a try.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/buddy-the-ai-mobile-browser/id6788047483

We're still figuring out distribution and what people would pay for. We'd appreciate any feedback, especially if you find anything that breaks or can suggest ways you think it could be made more useful.
